events.title: Defensive Breakthrough
events.description: Defensive tooling closes the gap for a whole class of attack – automated patching at the speed vulnerabilities are found, or detection that catches swarm behaviour rather than signatures – and the offence-defence balance visibly shifts back for the first time in years.

events.title: Taiwan Tension Rises
events.description: Extended military exercises, shipping insurance premiums rising, a diplomatic expulsion. Nothing that has not happened before, at a scale that is slightly harder to dismiss. **This is a precursor: it opens the Taiwan gate for the next 3 turns.**
